subject: Galaxy Health — implementation cadence, acceptance criteria and cutover timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya@galaxyhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Implementation cadence & acceptance checkpoints — Galaxy Health

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m sharing a concise working plan so the Galaxy Health team and our CS/Implementation squads are aligned on milestones, owners, and the acceptance criteria that will govern the cutover. I’ve attached the working MAP (GalaxyHealth_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and a brief checklist for acceptance items.

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week 1 (Dec 13–17): Kickoff, environment access, and initial SRE/IT runbook review (Owner: Galaxy IT / Redwood SE)
- Week 3 (Dec 27–31): Integration sprint — ingest, auth, and test harness (Owner: Redwood SE, Galaxy IT)
- Week 6 (Jan 17–21): Internal UAT; critical path regression tests (Owner: Galaxy QA)
- Week 8 (Jan 31–Feb 4): Cutover window & acceptance (Owner: Galaxy Product / Redwood CS)

Key acceptance checkpoints (short):
1) End-to-end smoke pass on sample dataset (30min window)
2) Latency within agreed SLOs for 95th percentile
3) Security checklist completed (audit log access, KMS key exchange)
4) Signed SOW and procurement confirmation for Dedicated nodes

Requested next steps:
- Can you confirm the procurement contact and a target DocuSign date?
- Is the Dec 27 integration sprint workable for your team?

Attachments: GalaxyHealth_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP), Acceptance_Criteria_Checklist.md

Thanks — I’ll loop Monica and Neha for resource alignment.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123


From: Maya Rao <maya@galaxyhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@galaxyhealth.com>, IT Lead <it@galaxyhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation cadence & acceptance checkpoints — Galaxy Health

Marcus,

Appreciate the clear plan — this looks good at a high level. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement: I’ve CC'd our procurement mailbox (procure@galaxyhealth.com). They’ll need the SOW and an itemized pricing summary to route through our internal approvals. Target internal PO decision: week of Jan 10.
- Cutover acceptance: our Product team needs a precise checklist for the UAT pass/fail criteria. The short acceptance bullets are helpful — can your team expand the test cases that demonstrate "latency within SLO" and what we should run for the smoke pass?
- Timeline concern: Dec 27–31 is a holiday-adjacent window for us. Could we shift the integration sprint to the week of Jan 3 instead? That would preserve resources.

Also attaching a contact for our security reviewer (it@galaxyhealth.com) who will request the SOC 2 evidence and KMS details.

If you can update the MAP with the revised sprint week and the expanded acceptance test matrix, I’ll share with Procurement and Product for alignment.

Thanks,
Maya Rao
Sr. Product Manager — Clinical Systems
Galaxy Health
maya@galaxyhealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation cadence & acceptance checkpoints — internal coordination

Folks,

Per Maya’s note, Procurement wants the SOW and a clear pricing breakdown; Product asked for test case detail. I’ve taken a pass at aligning owners in the MAP and expanded the acceptance matrix (see summary below). I also attached a one-page SOW summary (SOW_GalaxyHealth_v3.pdf) that we can send to procurement.

Proposed owner clarifications:
- Redwood SE (Sooj): Integration sprint tasks, API contract validation, test harness support
- Redwood CS (Monica): Runbook creation, acceptance orchestration, cutover runbook lead
- Account Exec (Marcus): Commercial signoffs, DocuSign tracking, executive escalations
- Galaxy IT/Prod/QA: environment provisioning, UAT, final acceptance sign-off

Acceptance matrix (expanded highlights):
- Latency verification: 1000 synthetic requests across target paths; 95th percentile latency < 250ms (measurement harness + logs to be shared)
- Data fidelity: Sample files validated against schema v2.1; >99.5% field match
- Security: KMS handshake validated, audit log snapshot available, SOC 2 artifact location shared (drive link in thread)
- Operational readiness: Monitoring alerts wired to Galaxy on-call, runbook run-through completed

Action items (owners & dates):
- Monica: finalize SOW summary and send to Procurement by Wed 12/16
- Soojin: deliver test harness script and run instructions by Fri 12/18
- Marcus: confirm DocuSign target date with Maya (Marcus)

I’ll hold off external sends until we align the revised MAP with their comments. If Marcus is comfortable, we can propose Jan 3 for the integration sprint and update the MAP accordingly.

— Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya@galaxyhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@galaxyhealth.com>, IT Lead <it@galaxyhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation cadence & acceptance checkpoints — final alignment and DocuSign

Maya / Procurement / Galaxy IT,

Thanks for the quick reviews. We updated the MAP with the adjusted integration sprint (Jan 3–7) and expanded acceptance test cases per Monica/Soojin’s notes. Key confirmations:

- Integration sprint: Jan 3–7 (Redwood SE and Galaxy IT leads)
- UAT window: Jan 17–21 (Galaxy QA)
- Cutover window: Feb 1–2 (final acceptance and rollback contingencies)
- Procurement: Monica attached SOW_GalaxyHealth_v3.pdf — please confirm PO route and target DocuSign by Jan 8 so we can reserve Dedicated capacity for Feb cutover.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GHY-map (MAP + acceptance checklist)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/1174

If Procure can confirm by Jan 8 we’ll lock resources and send a formal go/no-go checklist 7 days before cutover.

Appreciate the partnership — let us know if you want a short alignment call this week (30 min) to run through the acceptance harness.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
